d.d: A shelter from the wind, particularly temporary structures raised by shepherds to protect their flocks.
Alternative form of lue: to sift, particularly while mining tin or silver.
A sexually suggestive image, particularly one which does not involve full nudity.
The quality, state or instance of being lewd; promiscuous.
A cramp iron inserted into a cavity in order to lift heavy stones; used as a symbol of strength in Freemasonry.
The son of a Freemason, envisaged as assisting his father in heavy work or in old age.
A kind of shears used in cropping woollen cloth.
